summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a third closing of a previously disclosed private placement of Series A units. The company issued 195 units at $1,000 each, comprising convertible preferred stock and warrants, for $195,000 gross proceeds. The offering is a routine capital-raising under Rule 506(c) with a $5 million cap. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or abrupt management change occurred. The director departure item 5.02 is not detailed as a forced change; thus this 8-K does not meet the criteria for a special-situation category.
